text:
I added `slugify(title)` to `src/shop/core.py` as specified, with tests in `tests/test_slugify.py`. All 13 tests pass.

- **Implementation:** the title is lowercased, each run of characters outside `a-z0-9` becomes one `-`, and leading and trailing `-` are stripped.
- **Tests:** cover spaces and punctuation, digits, existing dashes, runs of separators, tabs and newlines, empty input, and input that is all non-ASCII or punctuation. A separate test checks that the result never starts or ends with `-` and never contains `--`.
- **Changelog:** added a line under "Unreleased" referencing PAY-4101.

Choices I made:
- The function lives in `core.py` beside `total()`, and I did not add it to `__init__.py`, which matches how `total()` is exposed. Import it as `from shop.core import slugify`.
- Non-ASCII letters are treated as separators, so `"Café Olé"` becomes `caf-ol`. Transliterating accents (`cafe-ole`) would be a different feature, so tell me if you want that.
- `slugify(None)` raises `AttributeError`; the spec didn't cover that case.

The repo isn't a git repository, so I didn't commit. pytest wasn't installed in the environment, so I ran it from a temporary venv at `/tmp/slug-venv`, outside the repo.
prompt: Add a new feature called slugify to this package (ticket PAY-4101). It should provide slugify(title): lowercase the text, replace every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single '-', and strip leading and trailing '-'. Also add tests.
